description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

You gain the supernatural ability to instantly understand any language. Once you've heard a language, however briefly, you both understand what is said and can speak it fluently. You'll have to learn to write the language as per normal however, although with the cost for Advances reduced by -5. Speaking a foreign language may not be freaking people out in itself, but if people perceive it as something supernatural they might understand that it is a mutation and react accordingly. You can only gain this mutation once.
